title: Sunny Cloudy Socal
description: An advanced interactive storytelling project focusing on complex datasets and user engagement through specialized visualization techniques.

title: Recommender Systems
description: A comprehensive study and implementation of recommendation algorithms, including collaborative filtering and predictive modeling, applied to large-scale datasets.

title: Cloudy Socal
description: An interactive data visualization exploring weather patterns in Southern California. This project uses maps and charts to analyze cloud coverage and other meteorological data across the region.

title: Shinse AI
description: An academic group project investigating the effectiveness of synthetic audio in training voice cloning models. We evaluated perceptual realism and speaker similarity using minimal real-world data.

title: Bikewatching Map
description: A web-based interactive map designed for cyclists to explore and discover bike-friendly routes. This tool visualizes bike path data, helping users plan their journeys more effectively.

title: Argumentative Visualization
description: An exploration into persuasive versus deceptive data visualization. This project presents two contrasting visualizations from the same dataset to highlight how design choices can influence interpretation.

title: Pathfinder
description: A wellness-focused web app to help students and young professionals explore career paths and gain self-awareness through personality insights, serving as a guide for personal and professional development.

title: Datamaid
description: A collaborative data science project focused on data cleaning, preprocessing, and analysis to streamline preparing datasets for machine learning.
